project_type: Python AI agent with AWS CDK infrastructure
build_system: hatchling build backend, pip for dependency installation, Docker for deployment
test_framework: pytest with tests/ directory, mypy strict mode, ruff linting, black formatting
test_command: cd agent && uv run pytest -v --tb=short && uv run mypy src/ && uv run ruff check . && uv run black --check .
verification_instructions: 1. Run uv sync --locked in agent/ to install deps. 2. Run uv run pytest to confirm tests pass. 3. Run uv run mypy src/ for type checking. 4. Run uv run ruff check . for linting. 5. Run uv run black --check . for formatting.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock - generated by uv lock command in agent/ directory. Must be committed.
setup_instructions: 1. cd agent. 2. uv sync (installs all deps including dev). 3. cp .env.example .env and add TAVILY_API_KEY.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access available. Python 3.13 available via pyenv. uv is pre-installed in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Run quality-check.sh before committing. Use conventional commit messages. All CI checks must pass (pytest, mypy, ruff, black).
key_patterns: pyproject.toml uses hatchling build system. Dockerfile uses python:3.13-slim base. GitHub Actions uses actions/setup-python with pip cache. quality-check.sh activates .venv and runs tools directly.
directory_structure: agent/ - Python agent code (src/, tests/, pyproject.toml, Dockerfile). cdk/ - AWS CDK TypeScript infra. .github/workflows/ - CI workflows. Root has docs and config files.
